posts.title: What objective is reasoning solving?
posts.description: There’s an intuitive but simplified picture of reasoning: let a model think for longer, and it’ll be more likely to be correct. This aligns well with our human intuition: spend more time and effort on thinking and it’s more likely that we’ll arrive at a correct answer. But this picture doesn’t seem to explain everything.
